unit: Paired target clusters; repeats retained; fixed datasets equally weighted
interval: Pointwise percentile conditional on fitted models, fixed dataset panel and sampled model compositions; no biological-replicate or retraining uncertainty
quantity: Arithmetic mean model scores per target; variability across compositions reported as IQR and range, not a biological CI
null: Mean score of ten permutations per target; replicate scores retained; not an exhaustive randomization test
coverage: Minimum covered-view count over fit/refit-derived test prediction contexts and splits for the same target; bins 0-6,7-9,10-12
proximity: Mean nearest-training similarity across contexts/splits, then tertiles within dataset using priors only
coverage_macro: Not aggregated across datasets because low-coverage bins may be absent in some datasets
p_values: No confirmatory p values or significance stars; all contrasts exploratory
